p: Monheim will remain the first backup and trusted fill-in on the interior offensive line.
The offensive line is thin on health, so Monheim's reliability helps protect the run game and Trevor Lawrence if a starter is out.
So we have a lot of confidence in Jonah.
Monheim stepped in for Hainsey and the offense kept moving the ball efficiently.
If Hainsey misses time, Monheim looks capable, so the offensive line should hold up for the skill players.
